basePrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production transparent PNG sprite for an existing lightweight 2D top-down police-and-robber game.
Input 1 is the exact low-resolution sprite to remaster, NOT a scene to redesign. Input 2 is the unchanged player character, ONLY a crisp linework/simple cel-color style reference; DO NOT draw any character.
Primary request: redraw input 1 faithfully at high resolution with genuinely sharp antialiased contours and clean flat/cel color boundaries as sharp as input 2. Output a single isolated sprite on true alpha transparency, no background/checkerboard, no scenery, no text except existing sign text. Keep the same silhouette, proportions, orientation, approximately 80-degree overhead camera, top/front balance, palette, component positions, and openings. Preserve relative dimensions precisely for pre-existing collision shapes. Whole sprite visible with small transparent padding. Simplify blurry noisy microtexture into clean shapes; no added realistic detail, no 3D render, no perspective tilt, no ground shadow, no glow, no white matte halo. This is resolution restoration, not a different art design. Aim for at least 1024px on the long image edge. Keep the asset aspect ratio from input 1, even on a padded output canvas.
